summary_rationale: Tanfac Industries has executed a credible structural upgrade since Anupam Rasayan's 2022 entry—doubling AHF capacity to 29,700 MTPA, becoming India's sole domestic Solar-Grade DHF producer with a ₹732 Cr Kredence contract through FY29, and fortifying net worth to ₹737 Cr (0.18x debt/equity, [ICRA]A+ Stable) via its 2026 QIP and preferential issue. However, the business remains CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than an unconditional compounder: operating margins compressed from 28% (Q3 FY25) to 11.84% (Q2 FY27) on sulphur/power inflation, CFO/EBITDA conversion lagged at 47%–56% in FY25–FY26, 100% of operations sit at one high-hazard Cuddalore site, and the ₹495 Cr HFC-32 capex cycle introduces execution and spread-reversion risk.
